game: IND @ LA Week 4 2025, kickoff 2025-09-28 16:05 ET, SoFi dome

script.base: LA is laying 3.5 in a dome with a 49.5 total, so the book has a competitive game, not a blowout: LA implied 26.5, IND implied 23.0. LA leads late and can hand Kyren Williams (55 carries, 226 yards in 3 games) clock work, while IND as a 3.5-point dog throws more and Jonathan Taylor's late rush volume is the part at risk. Pace should be normal-to-up in a dome; not a weather slog.
script.flip1: IND grabs an early lead behind Taylor (60 carries, 338 yards, 5.63 YPC through 3 games) and grinds the clock. Taylor's rush-under dies, LA abandons the run so Kyren's carries stall, and Puka Nacua (35 targets) and Davante Adams see pass-volume spikes.
script.flip2: Shootout toward the 49.5. Both passing games stay live. Alec Pierce is already out, so IND air yards funnel to Michael Pittman, Tyler Warren and Josh Downs rather than a deep shot. If Adams (questionable, hamstring) is limited, Nacua's target share rises further. A true LA blowout is the less likely third path and would cut starter pass snaps late.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and Taylor under 102.5 lost. IND got ahead, the dog-throws rule never kicked in, and Taylor was handed 22-plus clock carries. He ripped one explosive the way he did in the 165-yard game, and 20 carries at even 5.2 YPC clears 102.5 without needing a broken defense. LA's 3.92 YPC was a three-game sample against rushing attacks the pack does not name, and the backup guard held up, so efficiency never fell to the 3.9-4.5 range the under needs. The median was 102, so a normal Taylor day was always a hook loss waiting on one extra carry. That counter is real, which is why this stays a lean flag and not a strong sized bet. The Nacua over loses even more easily: 91 and 112 already missed, a 35% IND blitz plus a questionable Havenstein chops the 297 air yards, and nothing in the pack proves he is the slot receiver Moore's absence helps.
slip_story: One script only: competitive dome, LA -3.5, IND throws as the dog, LA's run front holds Taylor under his median. It belongs on a dog-pass / favorite-defense card, not a Taylor bellcow stack and not a shootout stack. Do not pair it with any Taylor over, a Kyren under, a total under, or IND receiving overs that need the Pierce targets to become yards. Nacua is not on the slip.
